title: Arrow Movement / fleet-path / 21017
description: Which path produces the entire final grid?
question: Use the 3 x 3 grid with x increasing right and y up. Read each command relative to the current heading. Move the stated distance and face the direction traveled. Stay inside the grid. Select the arrow at the named current cell. Only the landing cell matters. An occupant swaps back to the source and faces its own displacement. Which path produces the entire final grid?

answer.explanation: teal (1, 2) to (1, 0) facing S. Then teal (1, 0) to (0, 0) facing W, exchanging with blue facing E. Then green (0, 1) to (1, 1) facing E. Then blue (1, 0) to (1, 2) facing N. Every displayed constraint matches.
